Review: T1 has ERROR severity and literal fields event_id, file_id, and error_code. upload_failed maps to T1, and its guidance correctly requires ERROR. The contract is incomplete because required request_id is absent from T1. The auth_token prohibition is satisfied by the stated template fields.

Smallest supported repair: add request_id to T1’s required or literal field set, preserving the existing ERROR severity and other fields. Do not add auth_token.

Unresolved matters: whether request_id must be literal, structured, or merely required; field types and formatting; whether absent values are rejected or represented; and whether other events or templates are affected.

Verification boundary: this review establishes only static consistency against the supplied contract. It does not verify implementation, emitted logs, runtime severity, redaction behavior, field values, ingestion, or downstream consumers.
